technical_quality: Adequate: PA upright, midline trachea with symmetric clavicles (minimal rotation), adequate inspiration (~9 posterior ribs), adequate penetration; both costophrenic angles and lung apices included. Side marker (probable L) present at image upper right, consistent with conventional orientation.

devices.location: Image upper right corner, lateral to patient's left shoulder (external, not on patient)

abnormalities.finding: Patchy ill-defined airspace opacity extending from the left hilum to the left hemidiaphragm, partially silhouetting the medial left hemidiaphragm and left heart border margin (left lower lobe / lingular pneumonia pattern)
Milder patchy peribronchial / reticulonodular opacities along the right heart border in the right lower zone; right hemidiaphragm and right costophrenic angle remain sharp
Coarse, prominent bronchovascular markings bilaterally, more so in the lower zones (chronic bronchitic pattern vs. peribronchial infection)
Prominent, somewhat tortuous aortic knob (unfolded aorta), age-related
Cardiothoracic ratio borderline (~0.48); no definite cardiomegaly

description_zh: 胸部X光正位（PA）片，吸氣量與穿透度尚可，氣管居中。左側下肺野可見自左肺門延伸至橫膈的斑片狀、邊緣模糊之肺實質浸潤，內側左橫膈及部分左心緣輪廓變得不清（silhouette sign），範圍約8公分，符合左下葉/舌葉肺炎表現。右側下肺野內側亦見較輕微之支氣管周圍斑片狀陰影，兩側支氣管血管紋理粗糙增加，右橫膈及肋膈角仍清晰。主動脈弓稍突出、迂曲，心胸比約0.48，未見明顯胸水或氣胸，亦無胸管、導管、節律器等植入物。
